chunks: My father, may Allah grant him mercy, said: We were told by Sa’d bin Abdullah, from Ahmad bin Muhammad bin ‘Isa, from Qasim bin Yahya, from his grandfather, Hasan bin Rashid, from Abu’l-Hasan Musa bin Ja’far (peace be upon them both), who said:
He was asked about the meaning of "Allah", Glorious and Exalted is He, so he said: He has taken possession over the tiny and the magnified.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the name Allah according to Imam Musa al-Kadhim?
ai.summary: In this concise definition from *Mani al-Akhbar*, Imam Musa al-Kadhim (peace be upon him) elucidates the divine name 'Allah' as denoting absolute sovereignty over all existence, encompassing both the minute and the vast. This interpretation aligns with the Shia scholarly tradition of understanding divine names through their semantic roots, emphasizing that Allah’s dominion is all-encompassing and exclusive, thereby distinguishing Him from created beings who possess only partial control.

en.basel-kadem: 1.	My father, may Allah grant him mercy, said: We were told by Sa’d bin Abdullah, from Ahmad bin Muhammed bin ‘Isa, from Qasim bin Yahya, from his grandfather, Hasan bin Rashid, from Abu’l-Hasan, Musa bin Ja’far, peace be upon them both, that he said:
He was asked about the meaning of Allah, Glorious and Exalted is He, so he said: He has taken possession over the tiny and the magnified.
